hits.title: Numicolor
hits.description:
Discover a creative way to relax. Coloring by number helps you focus and switch off from daily worries. Many find it an excellent tool for stress relief and finding harmony.

Key features:

Growing image collection: Dive into popular categories like peaceful nature, stylish anime, fashion, and charming animals. Our collection is regularly updated with new works!

Flexible filter system: Find the perfect image quickly and easily. Use detailed filters by theme and difficulty to choose a coloring page for any mood.

Variety of game modes: Tired of the classic mode? Try the unique "Reveal" and "Mystery" modes to add a touch of intrigue to your coloring process.

For the whole family: The perfect app for adults looking to relax and for kids developing attention and creative skills.
hits.howToPlayText:
Choose a color from the palette.

Tap on the highlighted areas whose number corresponds to the selected color.

Use a hint to find an uncolored detail
